page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column, with a marginal note at the right of the first line of the second paragraph ("Caf. 11."); the left edge carries a strip of text from the neighbouring page (not transcribed). Running head at top centre, page number at top right, signature at the foot.

main_text.l: divinæ gratiæ poterit ista obligatio, velut
clypeus repellendæ tentationi idoneus,
ex adversum objici: nempe tentationi
non cedendum, sed animosius obniten-
dum; quia juramenti religione teneris,
ne id facias ad quod tentaris.
XIV. Casus Septimus est, ubi id quod ju-
ratur videtur ex eo illicitum, quod alteri
possit inde creari periculum Scandali;
præbendo sc. ei ex facto nostro occasi-
onem ruinæ. Plurima exstant eaque gra-
vissima in Epistolis Paulinis de vitando
scandalo monita: præsertim Rom. 14.
& 1 Cor. 8. & 10. Et sane viro vere Chri-
stiano summopere cavendum est, ut in
omni conversatione sua non propriæ
tantum conscientiæ consulat, sed & ædi-
ficationi alienæ; nec quærat quod sibi
utile est, sed quod multis; videatque
tam quid illis expediat, quam quid sibi
liceat: ne libertate sua abutatur in per-
niciem fratris. Sed quatenus a rebus li-
citis abstinendum sit ob scandalum vi-
tandum; nec paucis expediri poteft,
neque est præsentis instituti despicere.
Dicendum videtur, quod ad præsens ne-
gotium attinet, unius scandali periculum, si
nulla adsit alia ratio cur res illicita cen-
seatur, non sufficere ad impediendam
juramenti præstiti obligationem: sicut

page.notes: The left margin strip shows fragments of the adjacent page and is not transcribed. The note "Caf. 11." stands at the right beside the paragraph beginning "XIV." The line "XIV.Casus" is run into the paragraph; it is treated as a paragraph opening. Some words in the scan are uncertain (e.g. "quod multis" and "poterit") but were read as printed.
